title: Related Questions

answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 36932 Country: India Title: I have purchased a car from my friend on which loan was taken. He was unable to repay his loan installment so the bank issued a notice to forfeit his car Question: I have purchased a car from my friend on which loan was taken. He was unable to repay his loan installment so the bank issued a notice to forfeit his car. I bought it from him with the deal that he should sell it in entire amount outstanding as on date which includes loan interest plus principle. Is this deal allowable? I already have one more car. Answer ID: 36932 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 398/216/H=1433) According to Shariah your deal was right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
